title: DreamDojo · 人类视频到机器人世界模型流程图

description.zh: 通过真实视频素材与结构图结合，表达大规模人类视频预训练到具体机器人动作条件的两阶段训练体系。
description.en: A grounded mix of visual samples and schematic stages illustrating pretraining on human video and adaptation to robot embodiments.

zh: 需要寻找原创方法图/Teaser 的构图、模块分层和视觉叙事参考。
en: Looking for high-quality visual layout patterns for a scientific teaser or method figure.

zh: 视觉实例贯穿数据与训练阶段；预训练/后训练具有明确边界；最终应用不只是空泛模型图标。
en: Real visual examples connect data and stages, while training phases remain distinct; downstream usage is visible, not merely symbolic.

zh: 不能把作者 Method Overview 误称为训练代码或数据完全开源的证据；不复制源图到自己的论文。
en: A method illustration is not evidence that every training asset is open; do not copy the authors' figure into another paper.

insight.zh: 把真实人类视频、预训练和机器人动作适配放在不同信息区域，观众可以同时看见训练数据与下游目标，避免只看到抽象模型。
insight.en: Separate regions for human data, pretraining and embodiment adaptation let readers see the provenance and final purpose at once.
